com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc

Class DbcResourceManagerFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.ResourceManagerFactory
      • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc.DbcResourceManagerFactory

  • public class DbcResourceManagerFactory
extends ResourceManagerFactory
    Purpose of this factory is to create resource managers which are implemented using DBCAPI. The implementation may support only partial functionality, if it's not supported than the client will receive ResourceManagerException.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

      • acquireUsername

        public UsernameInfo acquireUsername(ConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
                             throws ResourceManagerException
        Description copied from class: ResourceManagerFactory
        Note: This is a synchronized call. This method is used to query the ConnectionManager for a username and password based on a Master account. The method takes in a ConnectionSettings object that can be populated with the following: host: The CM hostname/IP or a wild card, ie cm*.dataservices.theice.com username: Master account username password: Master account password Note : if the ConnectionSettings has the proxyUsername, proxyPassword, proxyHost and proxyPort set, this method will first instantiate the proxy settings before making a call to acquireUsername. This will return back a UsernameInfo object that will have the username and password filled in along with a returnCode. Check the returnCode to make sure that it is DbcCodes.DBCAPI.SUCCESS. You can check the error code against the DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERRROR codes. 
         For example,
 if (returnCode == DbcCodes.DBCAPI.SUCCESS) {
   //The username and password can now used to connect to the Connection Manager. 
 } else if (returnCode == DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR.INVALID_PARAM) {
   //Please check the required fields
 } else {
   //There was an internal error during processing, please report returnCode to support.
 }
        Specified by:
        acquireUsername in class ResourceManagerFactory
        Parameters:
        connectionSettings - with the master username, password and host information filled in the for the Connection Manager.
        Returns:
        a UsernameInfo object that will have the username and password filled in along with a returnCode
        Throws:
        ResourceManagerException - If acquireUsername is not implemented.
